claim: ATT&CK dates each campaign only to the month.
issue: The saved copy (docs/sources/_text/mitre2026attackkb.txt) holds only the home page and the Enterprise matrix, captured after v20 was released, so the passage is not in it. In the v19.1 bundle all 56 campaigns carry first_seen and last_seen on the first of a month (55 at T04-07:00Z on day 01, one at day 31 T23:00Z, which is the 1st in local time). For example, C0027: 2022-06-01 to 2022-12-01. Month precision holds. The campaign pages print "First Seen: June 2022".

claim: Reconnaissance and Resource Development happen largely outside the scope of the defender's controls.
issue: The saved copy (docs/sources/_text/mitre2026attackkb.txt) holds only the home page and the Enterprise matrix, captured after v20 was released, so the passage is not in it. The v19.1 bundle attaches, to 38 of 46 Reconnaissance and all 50 Resource Development technique entries, the text: "This technique cannot be easily mitigated with preventive controls since it is based on behaviors performed outside of the scope of enterprise defenses and controls." "Largely" fits. The clause after the cite (CTI reports rarely see them) is the dissertation's own inference, and reads as such.

claim: Persistence, Stealth and Command and Control keep a foothold, stay hidden and stay in contact throughout an attack.
locator: bundle data/gap/_attack/enterprise-attack-19.1.json, x-mitre-tactic TA0003, TA0005, TA0011 descriptions
issue: The saved copy (docs/sources/_text/mitre2026attackkb.txt) holds only the home page and the Enterprise matrix, captured after v20 was released, so the passage is not in it. The v19.1 tactic descriptions support the three verbs: Persistence "The adversary is trying to maintain their foothold."; Stealth "The adversary is trying to hide and conceal their actions, appearing as normal behavior."; C2 "The adversary is trying to communicate with compromised systems to control them." Nothing in ATT&CK says these last "throughout an attack". That is the dissertation's judgement, and it is what the 45 s choice rests on.
fix_text: "stay in contact throughout an attack [mitre2026attackkb], so" -> "stay in contact [mitre2026attackkb], which we judged to last throughout an attack, so"
